question_en:
1. **Identify the device in the attached image**
   Based on this image, identify the device's manufacturer and specific model, and confirm the main battery model it uses from the official specifications page.
2. **Filter models with specified rear features**
   Go to the brand's official website and use all camera body product cards loaded in this version of the catalog as the candidate range. Using the white-background images labeled as "rear" on the English global official website model pages corresponding to this version of the catalog, compare each one with the attached image to find models where a vertical connection structure extending along most of the screen height is visible on the left side of the screen. Please list all models that meet these criteria.
3. **Verify compatibility and weight, then sort**
   Among the models filtered in Question 2, based on the battery specifications and body net weight recorded on the same version of the pages, retain only those models that are explicitly compatible with the main battery confirmed in Question 1 and have a body net weight not exceeding 700 g. Sort them by starting price in this version of the US catalog from low to high; for the same price, sort by English model name A–Z. Please list the final qualifying models, battery model, and body net weight.

Answer format: For Question 1, provide the manufacturer, model, and main battery model in text; for Question 2, list all models with matching rear features in text; for Question 3, list the final models, battery model, and body net weight (g) in a table in the specified order.

| Z6III | EN-EL15c | 670 |
| Z f | EN-EL15c | 630 |
